blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Computed tomography (CT), cone-beam CT (CBCT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide complementary representations of the same underlying anatomy, yet substantial differences in image appearance challenge consistent segmentation and deformable registration in adaptive radiotherapy. We investigate whether dense anatomical segmentation supervision can promote cross-modality correspondence without explicit feature alignment. We introduce IMPACT-Seg, which segments 126 structures across CT, CBCT, and MRI using shared network parameters. A collection of 8,290 volumes was assembled from public cohorts through label harmonization, model-assisted pseudo-label completion, iterative refinement, and 2,864 physics-based CBCT simulations with voxel-aligned CT labels. Unpaired images were used to jointly train 2.5D and 3D residual-encoder networks.
  On 139 real CBCTs, IMPACT-Seg 3D achieved a mean Dice of 0.842 versus 0.671 for the strongest comparator. On 497 voxel-aligned CT-simulated-CBCT pairs, the CT-to-CBCT Dice decrease was 0.022 versus 0.153-0.178 for competing methods. On independent pancreatic radiotherapy CBCTs, gastrointestinal Dice was 0.735 versus 0.634 for TotalSegmentator. Prediction agreement reached 0.881 on registered CT-CBCT and 0.790 on CT-MRI pairs. Adding MRI training data reduced CT-MRI encoder feature retrieval error from 36.8 to 3.2 mm. Registration pipelines incorporating IMPACT-Seg features ranked first on two multimodal Learn2Reg benchmarks. The 3D model segmented a whole-body CT in 15 s.
  These findings show that dense anatomical segmentation supervision can support consistent anatomical representations across modalities, with applications to both segmentation and registration. Code, datasets, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/HEMONCedric/IMPACTSeg.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Adaptive radiotherapy relies on repeated imaging to account for anatomical changes during treatment. Planning computed tomography (CT), on-treatment cone-beam CT (CBCT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide different representations of the same underlying anatomy, despite substantial differences in image contrast, quality, and artefacts. Although anatomical structures may change in shape and position between acquisitions, their identity and delineation conventions should remain consistent across modalities. Accurate and consistent delineation is essential for contour adaptation, dose evaluation, and longitudinal assessment. As manual delineation of numerous structures is impractical within the time constraints of online adaptation, automated segmentation and registration-based contour propagation offer valuable alternatives [ 37 , 46 ] . Both approaches benefit from consistent anatomical identification despite differences in image appearance.
blocks.zh: 适应性放射疗法依靠反复成像来解释治疗过程中的解剖变化. 计算成像法(CT)、处理锥束CT(CBCT)和磁共振成像(MRI)在图象对比、质量和手工艺品方面都存在很大差异。 虽然解剖结构在获得之间可能发生形状和地位变化,但其特性和划界公约应始终以各种方式保持一致。 准确和一致的划定对于轮廓适应、剂量评估和纵向评估至关重要。 由于人工划定许多结构在网络适应的时限内是不切实际的,自动分区和以登记为基础的轮廓传播提供了宝贵的替代办法[37、46]。 尽管图像外观不同,但这两种方法都得益于一致的解剖鉴定。

blocks.en: Existing segmentation tools provide broad anatomical coverage on CT, including TotalSegmentator [ 55 ] , CADS [ 56 ] , and VISTA3D [ 17 ] . Joint CT-MRI segmentation is supported by MRSegmentator [ 16 ] and NV-Segment-CTMR [ 40 ] , while TotalSegmentator MRI [ 1 ] provides a dedicated MRI model. Differences in training distributions and label conventions nevertheless complicate their combined use in radiotherapy. CBCT adds scatter, noise, truncation, and motion artefacts, while dense annotations remain scarce. High accuracy on diagnostic CT or MRI therefore does not establish cross-modality consistency in the same patient.
blocks.zh: 现有的分解工具为CT提供了广泛的解剖覆盖,包括总分解器[55],CADS[56],和VISTA3D[17]. CT-MRI联合分离由MRSegment [16]和NV-Segment-CTMR [40]支持,而TotalSegmenter MRI [1]则提供专用的MRI模型. 然而,在培训分配和标签惯例方面的差异使其在放射治疗方面的综合使用复杂化。 CBCT增加了散射、噪音、截断和运动文物,而密集的记号仍然很少。 因此,诊断性CT或核磁共振的高精度不能确定同一病人的跨模式一致性。

blocks.en: This raises a central question: can a single model trained with harmonized anatomical supervision produce accurate and consistent segmentations across modalities, without explicitly enforcing feature alignment? To investigate this, we combine harmonized anatomical labels, joint multimodal training with shared network parameters, and physics-based CBCT simulation. Beyond segmentation accuracy and cross-modality prediction agreement, we examine whether this supervision promotes spatially corresponding anatomical representations and assess their utility for deformable image registration.
blocks.zh: 这提出了一个中心问题:一个受过统一解剖监督培训的单一模式能否在不明确执行特征调整的情况下,在模式之间产生准确和一致的分割? 为了调查这一点,我们把统一的解剖标签、联合多式联运培训与共享的网络参数以及基于物理学的CBCT模拟结合起来。 除了分解精确度和跨模式预测协议外,我们审查这种监督是否促进空间对应解剖表示,并评估其对可变形图像登记的作用。

blocks.en: IMPACT-Seg segments 126 structures from the head and neck to the pelvis using a single network with shared parameters across CT, CBCT, and MRI, without requiring paired inputs. Implemented with KonfAI, its 2.5D and 3D architectures benefit from fast, memory-efficient inference, achieving substantially shorter end-to-end runtimes than the evaluated nnU-Net-based pipelines (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: IMPACT-Seg从头部和颈部到骨盆共分126个部分,使用一个具有共享参数的单一网络,跨越CT,CBCT和核磁共振,而不需要配对输入. 与KonfAI一起实施,其2.5D和3D架构受益于快速,内存高效的推论,实现了远短于评价的nU-Net输油管运行时间(图1).

blocks.en: The contributions are: • a multimodal segmentation framework with a shared 126-structure label space and joint CT, CBCT, and MRI training; • a curated collection of 8290 public volumes, supported by annotation harmonization, model-assisted reference completion, and physics-based CBCT simulation with voxel-aligned labels; • a comprehensive evaluation of 2.5D and 3D segmentation models across CT, CBCT, and MRI, including comparisons with existing methods, training-data ablations, external validation, and reference-free failure detection; • an assessment of cross-modality correspondence in predictions and internal features, with downstream evaluation on two multimodal Learn2Reg registration tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Dense anatomical segmentation. nnU-Net [ 23 ] and its residual-encoder variants [ 25 ] provide strong volumetric baselines and underlie most of the frameworks below. Built on nnU-Net, TotalSegmentator [ 55 ] and CADS [ 56 ] established broad CT coverage, and MRSegmentator [ 16 ] and TotalSegmentator MRI [ 1 ] extended it to joint CT-MRI segmentation. VISTA3D [ 17 ] instead uses its own architecture to support automatic and interactive segmentation, and its multimodal extension NV-Segment-CTMR [ 40 ] also learns from CT and MRI jointly. AMOS [ 26 ] supports evaluation across CT and MRI, while SynthSeg [ 8 ] learns contrast-robust brain segmentation from synthesized images. Promptable models such as MedSAM [ 38 ] and nnInteractive [ 24 ] instead segment one structure at a time from user clicks, boxes, or scribbles. They accelerate annotation and correction but require interaction for each structure. These advances motivate assessing dense anatomical coverage together with prediction correspondence across radiotherapy modalities.
blocks.zh: 强烈解剖分裂。 nnU-Net[23]及其残余编码器变体[25]提供了强有力的量基线,并奠定了下文大多数框架的基础。 由nU-Net,TotalSiector[55]和CADS[56]搭建,建立了广泛的CT覆盖范围,MRSiector[16]和TotalSiectorMRI[1]将其扩展至CT-MRI联合区段. VISTA3D [17] 转而使用自己的架构来支持自动和交互分割,其多式联运扩展NV-Segment-CTMR [40] 也共同学习CT和MRI. AMOS [26]支持整个CT和核磁共振的评价,而SynthSeg [8] 从合成图像中学习对比-robust脑分裂. MeDSAM [38] 和nnInteractive [24] 等快速模型,而不是从用户点击,框,或拼写中一次分割一个结构. 它们加速注释和校正,但需要每个结构的互动。 这些进展促使人们评估密集的解剖覆盖,以及各种放射治疗方式的预测对应性。

blocks.en:
Learning across datasets and modalities. MultiTalent [ 53 ] combines CT datasets with conflicting label definitions. Hermes [ 15 ] conditions universal segmentation on task and modality priors, UniSeg [ 58 ] uses learned prompts for multi-task segmentation and representation transfer, and MulModSeg [ 33 ] combines unpaired CT and MRI through modality-conditioned text embeddings and alternating training. COSST and INERRANT use iterative pseudo-labeling to learn from partial annotations [ 36 , 41 ] .
IMPACT-Seg instead harmonizes references into one dense label map and shares a single network across modalities, without task- or modality-specific conditioning. Unlike the nnU-Net-based frameworks above, it is implemented and trained in KonfAI [ 9 ] , although its residual-encoder architecture follows similar design principles; memory-bounded patch inference segments a whole-body CT in seconds rather than minutes (Section 4.5 ). The released models are distributed as KonfAI applications. The scientific contribution centres on extending this supervision to CBCT and on evaluating accuracy, prediction agreement, and spatial feature correspondence within the same framework.
blocks.zh:
跨越数据集和模式的学习。 MultiTalent [53] 将CT数据集与相互矛盾的标签定义结合起来. Hermes [15] 对任务和模式前身的通用分割条件,UnisG [58] 使用学到的提示进行多任务分割和代表转移,MulModSeg [33] 通过模式条件的文本嵌入和交替训练,将未发酵的CT和核磁共振结合起来。 COSST和INERRANT使用迭代伪标签来学习部分说明[36,41].
相反,IMPACT-Seg将参考文献统一为一个密集的标签图,并共享一个跨模式的单一网络,不附带任务或模式特定条件。 与上面基于nnU-Net的框架不同,它是在KonfAI[9]中执行和培训的,尽管其残余编码器架构遵循类似的设计原则;内存绑定的补丁推论在几秒钟而不是几分钟内分解一个整体的CT(第4.5节)。 发行的模型作为KonfAI应用程序分发. 科学贡献的中心是将这种监督扩大到CBCT,以及评价同一框架内的准确性、预测协议和空间特征对应。

blocks.en: CBCT segmentation for radiotherapy. Limited annotations and acquisition artefacts have motivated several strategies: propagation of planning contours by deformable registration [ 35 ] , CBCT-to-CT synthesis before or jointly with segmentation [ 34 , 30 , 12 ] , direct training with limited CBCT annotations and complementary CT data [ 14 , 32 ] , and training on CBCT simulated from CT [ 2 , 12 ] . Most studies address a small set of organs within one anatomical region. The SynthRAD challenges [ 52 , 45 ] provide real CT-CBCT and CT-MRI data for broader multimodal evaluation, although correspondence-based analyses remain sensitive to the registration used to align the acquisitions [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 用于放射治疗的CBCT分离. 有限的说明和购置工艺推动了若干战略:通过可变形登记传播规划轮廓[35];在分解之前或与分解[34、30、12]联合进行CBCT合成[34、30、12];通过CBCT说明和补充CT数据进行直接培训[14、32];从CT[2、12]模拟进行CBCT培训。 大多数研究都针对一个解剖区内的一小撮器官. SynthRAD的挑战[52,45]为更广泛的多式联运评价提供了真正的CT-CBCT和CT-MRI数据,尽管基于通信的分析仍然对用于统一采购的登记十分敏感[10]。

blocks.en:
Anatomical representations and semantic similarity. Learned features provide an alternative to raw intensities for comparing images across modalities.
SAM [ 57 ] learns pixel-wise anatomical embeddings through self-supervised contrastive learning, and UAE [ 5 ] learns embeddings for cross-modality landmark matching.
Anatomix [ 13 ] uses randomized volumetric synthesis and contrastive learning to obtain representations robust to appearance variation, with applications to registration and few-shot segmentation.
IMPACT loss [ 11 ] compares features from pretrained segmentation models to define a semantic similarity objective for multimodal registration.
IMPACT-Seg uses dense segmentation in a shared anatomical label space as its sole training objective. After training, we assess the resulting cross-modality spatial correspondence and evaluate decoder feature similarity for registration.
blocks.zh:
解剖表达和语义相似. 所学的特征提供了一种替代原始强度的方法,用以比较各种模式的图像。
SAM [57]通过自我监督的对比性学习来学习像素-明智的解剖嵌入法,而阿联酋[5]则学习嵌入法用于跨模式地标匹配.
Anatomix [13] 采用随机化的体积合成和对比性学习,以获得对外观变异的强性表示,同时应用注册和几发分解.
IMPACT损失[11]比较了预先培训的分区模型的特点,以确定多式联运登记的一个语义相似目标。
IMPACT-Seg将共享解剖标签空间中的密集分解作为其唯一的培训目标。 经过培训,我们评估由此产生的跨模式空间通信,并评估解码器的登记特征相似。

blocks.zh: 协议没有将预测与参考说明进行比较,因此衡量一致性而不是正确性。 在两个图像上作出相同错误的方法会获得很高的一致,而在\\\\phi中,剩余错误的注册会降低它独立于分区质量. 因此,协定总是一并准确报告。

blocks.en: The framework combines a common non-overlapping label definition, CBCT simulation that preserves the source CT grid and annotations, and joint training with shared network parameters across modalities. Internal correspondence is then assessed through features F θ ℓ ​ ( x m ) F_{\theta}^{\ell}(x_{m}) at network depth ℓ \ell , and downstream utility through feature-driven deformable registration.
blocks.zh: 该框架结合了共同的非重叠标签定义,保留源CT网格和说明的CBCT模拟,以及跨模式共享网络参数的联合培训. 然后通过在网络深度l\ell的F θl(x m) F_{\theta}ell}(x_{m})特性评估内部通信,并通过特性驱动的变形登记来评估下游效用.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Curation and Harmonization
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集校准和协调

blocks.en: Each public cohort was converted to a common per-patient format comprising the image, its reference label map, and its source cohort. Label maps were stored on the voxel grid of their image, with its original spacing and origin. The collection comprises 8290 volumes: 4366 CTs from 15 cohorts; 552 MRIs from AMOS22, TotalSegmentator MRI, and the MRI component of the multimodal total-body dynamic PET/CT/MRI dataset (MTBD) [ 21 ] ; 229 MRIs and 279 CBCTs from SynthRAD2023 and SynthRAD2025 [ 52 , 45 ] ; and 2865 CBCT simulations derived from 955 TotalSegmentator CTs (Section 3.4 ). Together, the cohorts cover the head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, and musculoskeletal anatomy, with MRI contributing abdominal, pelvic, and whole-body acquisitions. Table 1 lists the cohorts with their pairing, fold partition, and use in each experiment.
blocks.zh: 每个公共群体被转换为普通的每名患者格式,包括图像、其参考标签地图及其来源群体。 标签地图被存储在其图像的voxel网格上,其原间隔和来源. 该汇编包括8 290卷:来自15个组群的4366个CT;来自AMOS22的552个MRI、总分区磁共振磁共振磁共振磁共振元件以及多式联运全体动态PET/CT/MRI数据集的磁共振元件[21];来自SynthRAD2023和SynthRAD2025[52,45]的229个MRI和279个CBCT;以及来自955个总分区磁共振磁共振磁共振磁共振磁共振磁共振磁共振元件(第3.4节)。 组群一起覆盖头部和颈部,胸骨,腹部,骨盆,以及肌肉骨骼解剖学,核磁共振贡献腹部,骨盆,以及全身的获得. 表1列出了各组别及其配对、折叠分区以及每个实验中的使用。

blocks.en: All volumes were reoriented to RAS, and image-label geometry, intensity scaling, laterality, anatomical numbering, and label-volume outliers were audited. Flagged cases were corrected or excluded when their metadata could not be trusted. Detailed geometry checks and spacing criteria are given in Section S2 .
blocks.zh: 所有卷都重新定向到RAS,并审计了图像标签几何、强度缩放、后期、解剖编号和标签量输出器。 标有标记的案件在元数据无法信任时被纠正或排除在外。 详细的几何检查和间隔标准见S2节。

blocks.en: Shared label space. All cohorts, whether CT, MRI, real CBCT, or simulated CBCT, are annotated in one label space. It follows the label definitions of CADS [ 56 ] , from which 131 classes were retained, 126 of which are evaluated (Section 3.5 ). Because each voxel carries a single label, classes that enclose finer ones were removed: the whole heart, for example, is represented by the four cardiac chambers and the myocardium, the larynx by the glottis and supraglottis, and the peritoneal cavity by the abdominal organs it contains. The few voxels still claimed by two labels were assigned by a fixed priority between the CADS sub-models from which the labels originate. The label map covers abdominal and pelvic organs, bowel, lung lobes, cardiac chambers and major vessels, individually numbered vertebrae and ribs, major bones and muscles, and head-and-neck organs at risk (Figure S6 ). Training, stored references, and evaluation use the same label convention.
blocks.zh: 共享标签空间 。 所有组别,无论是CT,核磁共振,真CBCT,还是模拟CBCT,都会在一个标签空间中附加注释. 它沿用CADS[56]的标签定义,从中保留了131个类别,其中126个类别得到评价(第3.5节)。 因为每个阴道都带有一个单一的标签,所以将那些包含更细的:例如,整个心脏由四个心室和心肌所代表,喉部由格氏和超格洛蒂所代表,腹腔由它包含的腹腔所代表. 少数仍然由两个标签声称的Voxel被指定在标签来源于的CADS子模型之间固定的优先权. 标签图涵盖腹部和骨盆器官、肠道、肺叶、心脏室和主要血管、个别编号的椎骨和肋骨、主要骨骼和肌肉以及有危险的头颈器官(图S6)。 培训、存储参考和评价使用同样的标签公约。

blocks.en: 3.3 Reference Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.3 注释管道

blocks.en: Each source dataset annotates only a subset of the 126 structures. Directly combining these datasets would therefore introduce incomplete and inconsistent supervision, with unannotated structures treated as background. To address this, we used model-assisted pseudo-labeling to complete the references in a shared label space, followed by iterative refinement to reduce missing or anatomically implausible annotations.
blocks.zh: 每个源数据集仅对126个结构中的一个子集进行注释. 因此,直接合并这些数据集将带来不完整和不一致的监督,未加说明的结构被视为背景。 为了解决这个问题,我们使用模型辅助伪标签在共享标签空间中完成引用,然后进行迭代改进,以减少缺失或解剖不可信的说明。

blocks.en: (i) Source annotations were mapped to the shared label space and kept unchanged in all later steps.
blocks.zh: (i) 将原始说明绘制到共享标签空间,并在以后所有步骤中保持不变。

blocks.en: (ii) Voxels without a source label were filled with the predictions of an existing modality-specific model: CADS [ 56 ] for CT, and NV-Segment-CTMR [ 40 ] , with selected labels such as the vertebrae taken from TotalSegmentator MRI [ 1 ] , for MRI. Simulated CBCTs inherit the completed reference of their source CT. For SynthRAD ( registration files ) and MTBD, whose MRIs and CBCTs are paired with a CT of the same patient, the reference was built on that CT and transferred on the shared grid to the registered CBCT or MRI; selected MRI labels were then replaced by TotalSegmentator MRI predictions on the MRI itself.
blocks.zh: (二)没有源标签的Voxels被填充了对现有模式特定模型的预测:CT的CADS [56],和NV-Segment-CTMR [40],其选定的标签如从TotalSegmentator MRI [1],用于核磁共振. 模拟的CBCT继承了源代码CT的完整参考. 对于SynthRAD(注册文件)和MTBD,其MRIs和CBCT与同一个病人的CT配对,参考基于该CT,并在共享网格上转移到已注册的CBCT或核磁共振;然后选定核磁共振标签被MRI本身的TotalSegmentator核磁共振预测取代.

blocks.en: (iii) The initial pseudo-labels were further refined over successive training generations. At each generation, an independent network was trained on the current references, and its predictions were used to complete missing structures and replace implausible automatically generated annotations within anatomically plausible regions. The refined references were then used to train the next generation, progressively updating the pseudo-labels while preserving the original source annotations.
blocks.zh: (三)经过历代培训,进一步完善了最初的伪标签. 在每一代人中,都对一个独立的网络进行了关于当前参考资料的培训,其预测被用来完成缺失的结构,并取代在解剖学上可信的区域内无法自动生成的说明。 随后,精细的参考文献被用于培养下一代,在保留原始源说明的同时,逐步更新伪标签.

blocks.en: (iv) All completed references were visually reviewed, and erroneous structures were corrected manually or interactively with nnInteractive [ 24 ] . MRI required the most correction: 16 of 58 AMOS-MR cases and 218 of 374 TotalSegmentator-MRI cases were edited, mostly for structures missing from the automatic predictions. All methods were evaluated against the same references.
blocks.zh: (四)所有已完成的参考文献都经过目视审查,错误的结构由人工或与nnInteractive [24]交互纠正. 核磁共振最需要更正:58个AMOS-MR案件中的16个和374个总分管-MRI案件中的218个被编辑,大多是因为自动预测中缺失的结构。 所有方法都参照同样的参考标准加以评价。

blocks.en: 3.4 CBCT Simulation
blocks.zh: 3.4 CBCT 模拟

blocks.en:
CBCTs were simulated from 955 TotalSegmentator CT volumes with the Reconstruction Toolkit (RTK) [ 44 ] . CT-derived attenuation volumes were projected with circular cone-beam geometries representative of on-board imagers and reconstructed with FDK onto the source CT grid, preserving voxel-wise label correspondence (Figure 2 ).
CBCT simulations used five scanner profiles derived from the acquisition parameters of the SynthRAD2025 centres (three Elekta XVI configurations, one IBA Proteus, and one Varian TrueBeam on-board imager). Each profile defined the acquisition geometry, tube current, exposure time, and detector characteristics. Three realizations were generated per CT, each with an independently sampled scanner profile and randomly enabled artefacts of varying severity. These included noise, scatter, detector imperfections, shading, truncation, miscentring, respiratory motion, and metal artefacts representative of radiotherapy CBCT [ 3 ] . Projections used a monoenergetic attenuation model, without explicit beam-hardening simulation. Further implementation details are provided in Section S2 .
blocks.zh:
CBCT是用重建工具包(RTK)模拟的955个总分号CT卷[44]. CT衍生的衰减体积以圆锥束几何仪进行预测,代表机载成像仪,并用FDK重建到源CT网格上,保存阴性标签对应(图2)。
CBCT模拟使用了从SynthRAD2025中心的获取参数中衍生出来的5个扫描仪剖面(3个Elekta XVI配置,1个IBA Proteus,1个Varian TrueBeam在机载成像仪). 每个剖面都定义了获取几何,管流,曝光时间,以及探测器特征. 每个CT生成三个实现,每个都具有独立的取样扫描仪剖面和不同严重程度的随机生成的手工艺品。 这些问题包括噪音、散射、探测器不完善、阴影、截流、误点、呼吸运动以及代表放射疗法CBCT的金属制品[3]。 预测使用了单电源衰减模型,没有明显的光束硬化模拟。 第S2节进一步详细介绍了执行情况。

For two patients, the source CT and three simulated CBCT realizations on the same axial slice, with the scanner geometry and the artefacts simulated for each realization. Implants appear on the displayed slices: sternal wires (thorax, Varian OBI) and a hip prosthesis (pelvis). The CBCTs are reconstructed back onto the CT grid and inherit its labels voxel by voxel.

blocks.en: 3.5 Networks and Training
blocks.zh: 3.5 网络和培训

blocks.en: The 2.5D and 3D residual-encoder U-Nets were implemented in KonfAI [ 9 ] and trained jointly on all modalities, without modality-specific heads or fine-tuning. Images were resampled to 1.5 × 1.5 × 2.0 1.5\times 1.5\times 2.0 mm and standardized to zero mean and unit variance over the volume. The networks predict 126 evaluated structures plus background. Five additional output classes (the cochleae, optic chiasm, and optic nerves) were not reliably learned at this resolution and were suppressed in every evaluation.

The 3D network uses single-channel 128 3 128^{3} patches, instance normalization, and a batch size of one. Both were trained in mixed precision for 2 000 000 2\,000\,000 SGD steps with Nesterov momentum 0.99, weight decay 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , and an initial learning rate of 0.01 decayed polynomially with exponent 0.9. Encoder specifications and augmentations are detailed in Section S2 .

blocks.en: Training-data ablation. Four additional 2.5D networks, trained on the fold-1 partition (Section 3.6 ), assessed the training modalities using a common, shorter AdamW training schedule and a fixed checkpoint at 200 000 steps (Section S2 ). Training sets comprised CT only (624 volumes), CT plus real CBCT (763), CT plus real and simulated CBCT (1248, including 485 simulations), and all modalities (1872, adding 624 MRI volumes). Slices were sampled uniformly, yielding CBCT shares of 10% with real CBCT alone and 45% with simulations. Validation used only the included modalities; all variants were evaluated on identical fold-1 test and benchmark patient-label pairs, with each configuration compared against its predecessor.
blocks.zh: 培训数据开发。 另有四个2.5D网络在折叠1分区(第3.6节)上接受培训,利用一个共同的、较短的AdamW培训时间表和一个200 000步的固定检查站评估了培训方式(第S2节)。 培训集只包括CT(624卷),CT加真CBCT(763卷),CT加真和模拟CBCT(1248卷,包括485个模拟),所有模式(1872卷,增加了624个核磁共振卷). 切片被统一采样,产生的CBCT份额为10%,只有真正的CBCT,而45%的CBCT则有模拟效果. 验证只使用包含的模式;所有变体都通过相同的折叠-1测试和基准病人标签对子进行考核,每个配置与前一个配置相比.

blocks.en: 3.6 Data Splits, Model Selection and Inference
blocks.zh: 3.6 数据分割、模型选择和推论

blocks.en: Five patient-stratified folds were constructed with 781 cases per modality (CT, CBCT, MRI) per fold with 624 for training, 100 for validation, and 57 for testing. Thus, each training fold contained 1872 volumes equally balanced across the three modalities. CT and CBCT cases were rotated across folds, whereas for MRI, test cases were randomly resampled from the available training pool for each fold due to limited data availability. Not all cases were utilized by the splits, therefore those left-over cases are used for further evaluations (see 3.7 ). Each network (2.5D and 3D) was trained once per fold, giving five models per network; the model trained on the training partition of fold k k is referred to as the fold- k k model.
blocks.zh: 建造了5个患者分级的折叠,每折叠781例(CT、CBCT、核磁共振),培训624例,验证100例,测试57例。 因此,每套培训包含1,872卷,在三种模式中均衡兼顾。 CT和CBCT的病例在折叠式之间旋转,而磁共振的试验病例则由于数据有限而从每个折叠式的现有培训库中随机重印。 并非所有案件都用于拆分,因此这些剩余案件用于进一步评价(见3.7)。 每个网络(2.5D和3D)每折叠一次训练,每个网络给出5个模型;关于折叠kk训练分区训练的模型被称为折叠-kk模型.

blocks.en: CT sampling was proportional to source-cohort size to retain dataset diversity; CBCT selection covered anatomical regions and noise conditions while excluding simulated variants of TotalSegmentator test patients. All acquisitions and simulated variants of a patient remained in the same partition within a fold. Validation loss was measured every 100 000 100\,000 steps on the 300 validation cases, and the checkpoint with the lowest loss was retained.
blocks.zh: CT取样与源码大小成正比,以保留数据集的多样性;CBCT选择涵盖解剖区和噪声条件,但不包括TotalSegmentator测试病人的模拟变体. 患者的所有购置品和模拟变体都处于一个折叠内的同一分区。 300件鉴定案件每10万个100000个步骤测得验证损失,损失最低的检查站被保留.

blocks.en:
Inference uses the training preprocessing, patch size, and 50% overlap. At each voxel, the label of the most confident patch is retained. The label map is restored to the native grid by nearest-neighbour interpolation rather than by resampling the class probabilities, which keeps inference memory-bounded but limits boundary precision at native resolution.
Each case uses one eligible fold model. On external TotalSegmentator v3 cohorts, an additional ensemble averages the five folds’ softmax predictions before patch assembly. Section S9 compares confidence-based assembly with Gaussian-weighted probability averaging.
blocks.zh:
推论使用训练预处理,补丁大小,以及50%的重叠. 在每个阴道上,保留最自信的补丁的标签. 标签图通过近邻的插图,而不是通过类概率的复标,恢复到本土的网格上,这种图保持了内存限制,但在本土解析时限制了边界精度.
每个案例都使用一个合格的折叠模型. 在外部的 TotalSegmentator v3 组别上,一个额外的综艺平均在补丁组装之前就预测了五折叠的软max. S9节将基于信心的组装与高斯加权概率平均值进行比较.

blocks.en: 3.7 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.7 评价议定书

blocks.en:
Out-of-fold evaluation. As CT and CBCT rotated across folds, trained models were evaluated on the hold-out test set. Cases were segmented by a fold model if the case was present in the respective test set. Left over cases from the split were assigned to a fold model and encoded with a fixed hash.
For simulated CBCT, the patient is identified by its source CT, so that no model is evaluated on a CBCT derived from a training CT.
blocks.zh:
外道评价. 随着CT和CBCT在折叠间旋转,在搁置测试中评价了训练有素的模型. 如果案件在相应成套测试中存在,则用折叠模型对案件进行分割。 拆分中遗留下来的案件被分配到折叠模型中,并用固定散列编码.
对于模拟的CBCT来说,患者由其来源CT识别,因此没有从训练CT中得出的CBCT上评价模型.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and compared methods. CADS [ 56 ] , TotalSegmentator [ 55 ] , and NV-Segment-CTMR [ 40 ] were evaluated on CT and CBCT; MRSegmentator [ 16 ] , TotalSegmentator MRI [ 1 ] , and NV-Segment-CTMR on MRI. As MRSegmentator and TotalSegmentator MRI also support CT segmentation, both were applied to CT and MRI for the cross-modality prediction agreement analysis. Fixed software and weight versions are listed in Table S1 ; released inference settings and verified shared-label mappings were used. CADS was excluded from VISCERAL because of training overlap. Competing CT frameworks had access to the TotalSegmentator source cohort of the simulated CBCT benchmark, whereas IMPACT-Seg excluded the evaluated patients from training and validation. External evaluation used cases added in version 3 of the TotalSegmentator datasets (712 CT and 680 MRI volumes absent from version 2). The evaluated TotalSegmentator weights predate this release, but training overlap cannot be excluded (Section S2 ). Shared eligibility and prediction-availability criteria yielded 247 CT and 253 MRI volumes (Section S1 ).
blocks.zh: 基准和比较方法。 CADS [56],总分号 [55],NV-Sement-CTMR [40] 在CT和CBCT上进行了评价;MRSSector [16],总分号核磁共振 [1],NV-Secment-CTMR在核磁共振上进行了评价. 由于MRS配对器和TotalS配对器MRI也支持CT配对,两者都应用于CT和MRI,用于跨模式预测协议分析. 固定软件和重量版本列于表S1;发布了推论设置,并使用了经核实的共享标签映射. 由于培训重叠,CADS被排除在VISCERAL之外。 相互竞争的CT框架可访问模拟CBCT基准的总分区源组,而IMPACT-Seg将受评估的病人排除在培训和验证之外。 外部评价使用了在TotalSegates数据集第3版中添加的案例(第2版中没有712个CT和680个磁共振卷). 评估的总分区加权数在本版发布之前就已公布,但不能排除培训重叠(S2节)。 共同的资格和预测可用性标准得出247个CT和253个核磁共振卷(S1节)。

blocks.en: External radiotherapy CBCT. Independent validation used the Pancreatic-CT-CBCT-SEG collection [ 22 ] : 40 patients treated with ablative radiotherapy for locally advanced pancreatic cancer at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, each with a contrast-enhanced planning CT and two non-contrast treatment CBCTs (Varian TrueBeam or OBI on-board). All images were acquired in deep-inspiration breath-hold verified with an external respiratory monitor. Expert contours cover the small bowel and stomach-duodenum within the low-dose planning target volume plus a 1 cm margin; ten CBCTs have two independent observers. Stomach and duodenum predictions were merged. Their union with the small bowel was evaluated as a single gastrointestinal (GI) region to reduce sensitivity to differing duodenal label definitions. Rigidly propagated planning-CT contours and inter-observer agreement on the ten CBCTs annotated by two observers were included as clinical comparators.
blocks.zh: 外部放射治疗 CBCT. 独立验证 使用 Pancreatic-CT-CBCT-SEG 收集[22]:40名患者在纪念斯隆·凯特灵癌症中心接受当地先进胰腺癌的乳化放射治疗,每个患者都有对比增强的CT计划以及两个非连续治疗 CBCT(机上Varian TrueBeam或OBI). 所有图像都是通过深呼吸屏蔽得到的,并经过外部呼吸监视器的核实。 专家轮廓覆盖低剂量规划目标体积内的小肠和胃脏;10个CBCT有2个独立观察者。 胃部和杜德纳姆预测被合并. 他们与小肠的结合被评价为单肠胃(GI)区域,以降低对不同双肠道标签定义的敏感性. 严格宣传的规划-CT轮廓和观察员间关于两个观察员注解的十种CBCT的协议被列为临床参照物。

blocks.en: Metrics. Dice, 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and average symmetric surface distance (ASD) were computed for the shared reference structures; distances are reported in millimetres. For comparisons with existing methods, only structures annotated in the original source datasets were evaluated, excluding automatically generated annotations to avoid favouring any of the models used for reference completion. Structures absent from the reference were not scored because the annotations do not exhaustively cover every field of view. All methods in a paired comparison were evaluated on the same cases and patient-label pairs.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 为共享的参考结构计算了第95百分位的Husdorff距离(HD95)和平均对称的表面距离(ASD);距离以毫米表示。 为与现有方法进行比较,只评价了原始源数据集中附加说明的结构,但不包括自动生成的说明,以避免偏向任何用于完成参考的模型。 参考文献中缺少的结构没有打分,因为说明没有详尽地涵盖每个视野。 在对等比较中的所有方法都在同一病例和病人标签对等上进行了评价。

blocks.en: Statistics. Metrics were averaged across evaluated structures within each case and then summarized across cases, with mean ± \pm standard deviation values provided in the Supplementary Material. The primary endpoint was per-case mean Dice. Two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests compared each framework with each IMPACT-Seg network and the two networks with one another, with Holm correction across comparisons within each benchmark. Mean Dice confidence intervals were obtained by patient-level bootstrap with 10 000 10\,000 resamples and are reported for IMPACT-Seg in Table S26 . HD95 and ASD were secondary endpoints, outside this family of tests. Unless stated otherwise, p p -values reported in the Results compare the 2.5D network with each competitor, and 3D comparisons are given when their conclusion differs. HD95, ASD, and label-wise results are reported in the supplementary material. Statistical significance was interpreted alongside the magnitude and anatomical relevance of each difference.
blocks.zh: 统计。 每种情况中,平均按评价结构进行计量,然后按补充材料中提供的平均值±\pm标准差汇总。 主要终点是每起案件的平均剂量。 双面配对的威尔科森签名排名测试将每个框架与每个IMPACT-Seg网络和两个网络相互比较,霍尔姆在每个基准内通过比较校正. 平均值 剂量的置信间隔是通过病人的靴子得到的,重印量为10 000 10\ 000,并在表S26中报告了IMPACT-Seg。 HD95和ASD是二级终点,在这个测试家族之外. 除非另有说明,结果中报告的p - 值与每个竞争者比较2.5D网络,当其结论不同时给出3D比较。 HD95、ASD和标签结果在补充材料中报告。 在解释统计意义的同时,还解释了每一种差异的规模和解剖相关性。

blocks.en: Domain shift and consistency. Cross-modality robustness was assessed using two complementary metrics. Dice degradation was defined as the difference between segmentation accuracy on CT and CBCT for the same patient, computed over the same eligible structures: Δ Dice = Dice CT − Dice CBCT . \Delta_{\mathrm{Dice}}=\mathrm{Dice}_{\mathrm{CT}}-\mathrm{Dice}_{\mathrm{CBCT}}. (4) Positive values indicate lower segmentation accuracy on CBCT.
blocks.zh: 域移与贯贯. 采用两个互补的衡量标准评估了跨模式稳健性。 滴滴降解被定义为同一患者在CT和CBCT上的分化精度之差,通过相同的合格结构计算: QQ Dice = Dice CT – Dice CCT = CBCT 。\Delta_{\ _{\ mathrm{Dice}}=\ mathrm{Dice}_{\ mathrm{CT}} -\mathrm{Dice}_{\ mathrm{CBCT}}}. (4)正值表示CBCT的分解精度较低.

blocks.en: Prediction agreement was defined as the mean per-structure Dice between predictions obtained independently on two modalities after bringing them into a common coordinate system (Eq. 1 ). Unlike accuracy, agreement does not measure correctness against a reference, as two predictions may agree while sharing the same errors.
blocks.zh: 预测协议的定义是,在将两种模式引入共同坐标系统后,在两种模式上独立获得的预测之间,每结构的平均剂量(Eq.1 )。 与准确性不同的是,协议不对照参考来衡量正确性,因为两种预测可能一致,同时分享同样的错误.

blocks.en: Simulated CBCTs were reconstructed on the grid of their source CT and shared its reference, allowing both metrics to be evaluated without inter-acquisition anatomical changes. For real CT-CBCT and CT-MRI pairs, the images were aligned to the planning CT with the IMPACT-Reg pipeline using TotalSegmentator features Boussot et al. [10] . All methods used the same registered pairs and shared labels. Residual registration errors and anatomical differences may affect the measured consistency. CT-side accuracy against CT-derived references was therefore not interpreted as independent validation on these real pairs.
blocks.zh: 模拟的CBCT在来源CT的网格上进行了重建,并分享了其参考文献,使两个度量衡能够在不发生采购间解剖变化的情况下得到评价。 对于真正的CT-CBCT和CT-MRI配对,图像与规划的CT一致,使用TotalSegmentator功能Boussot等人的IMPACT-Reg管道。 [10] (中文(简体) ). 所有方法都使用相同的注册对和共享标签. 剩余登记错误和解剖差异可能影响测量的一致性。 因此,CT侧准确性相对于CT衍生的参考,不解释为对这些真对进行独立验证。

blocks.en: 3.8 Feature-Level Consistency Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.8 特征-一致性分析

blocks.en: Training constrains only the predicted label maps, without explicitly enforcing feature correspondence across modalities. We investigate whether shared segmentation supervision nevertheless produces representations that are both consistent at anatomically corresponding positions and spatially discriminative. These properties are distinct: features encoding only anatomical identity, as the output probabilities do, may be similar across modalities yet unable to distinguish positions within the same structure. Deformable registration requires both: features must agree at corresponding positions and provide spatially localized similarity.
blocks.zh: 培训只限制预测的标签地图,而没有明确执行跨模式的特征对应。 我们调查共享分解监督是否仍然产生在解剖对应位置一致和空间歧视性的表述。 这些属性是截然不同的:像输出概率一样,特性只编码解剖特征,在模式上可能相似,但却无法区分同一结构内的位置。 可变形登记既要求:特征必须在相应的位置上达成一致,并提供空间本地化的相似性。

blocks.en: 3.9 Application to Multimodal Registration
blocks.zh: 3.9 对多式联运的适用

blocks.en: Decoder features were evaluated as a similarity representation for deformable registration on the Learn2Reg AbdomenMRCT and ThoraxCBCT tasks [ 20 ] . We built upon our previous IMPACT-Reg work [ 11 ] , which demonstrated the utility of pretrained segmentation features from TotalSegmentator as a semantic similarity measure for multimodal registration within a multi-resolution Elastix framework. For AbdomenMRCT, the previous approach used deep features from the TotalSegmentator M730 model, extracted in static mode and compared using an L1 distance after affine initialization. For ThoraxCBCT, early features from the M730/M731 models were used in Jacobian mode, allowing gradients to propagate through the feature extractor. In the present work, the same feature-based registration principle was retained, while the similarity representation was replaced by features from the jointly trained IMPACT-Seg network.
blocks.zh: 解码器特性被评价为在Learn2Reg AbdomenMRCT和ShoraxCBCT任务上可变形注册的类似代表[20]. 我们借鉴了我们先前的“影响控制”规则工作[11],该工作表明,在多分辨率 " 埃拉斯蒂克斯 " 框架内,在多式联运登记方面,从总分包器中预加训练的分包功能作为语义上的类似措施是有用的。 对AbdomenMRCT来说,前一种方法使用了来自TotalSegmentator M730模型的深层特征,在静态模式中提取,并在affine初始化后使用L1距离进行比较. 对于ShoraxCBCT来说,M730/M731模型的早期特征被用于雅各布模式,使得梯度可以通过特征提取器传播. 在目前的工作中,保留了同样的基于特征的登记原则,而类似的代表被联合培训的IMPACT-Seg网络的特征所取代。

blocks.en: For AbdomenMRCT, ConvexAdam [ 50 ] initialized the deformation from the predicted liver, spleen, and kidney segmentations. Subsequent refinement minimized the L1 distance between the fixed and warped moving features from the last IMPACT-Seg decoder layer, with diffusion regularization: 160 Adam iterations were followed by 180 iterations on a control grid with two-voxel spacing. Segmentation masks were used for initialization only.
blocks.zh: 对AbdomenMRTCT来说,康维克斯亚当[50]初始化了预测的肝,脾,肾分裂的变形. 其后的改进将固定移动特性和扭曲移动特性之间的L1距离从上一层IMPACT-Seg解码器中最小化,扩散规范化: 160 亚当迭代之后在控制网格上进行了180次迭代,间隔为两伏. 片面口罩只用于初始化。

blocks.en: For ThoraxCBCT, the previous Elastix-IMPACT pipeline [ 11 ] was retained for initialization. Refinement combined last-decoder IMPACT-Seg feature similarity, MIND-SSC descriptors [ 18 ] , and diffusion regularization, with 60 iterations at approximately 4 mm and 100 iterations at 2 mm.
blocks.zh: 对于ShoraxCBCT,之前的ELastix-IMPACT管道[11]被保留用于初始化. 完善上一个解码器IMPACT-Seg的特征相似性,MIND-SSC描述符[18],以及扩散规范化,60个重迭约4毫米,100个重迭约2毫米.

blocks.en: 3.10 Uncertainty Estimation and Failure Detection
blocks.zh: 3.10 不确定性估计和失败检测

blocks.en: We investigated whether segmentation failures could be detected without reference annotations at inference time. A failure was defined as a structure with a reference Dice below 0.7, with 0.5 used in a secondary analysis. Evaluation was performed on the external TotalSegmentator v3 CT and MRI cohorts, unseen by all fold models. Three voxel-wise uncertainty signals were compared to identify structures at risk of failure.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Consistent Anatomy Across Modalities
blocks.zh: 4.1 始终如一的解剖方法

blocks.en: We first assess prediction consistency on voxel-aligned CT-CBCT pairs, then on registered real CT-CBCT and CT-MRI pairs. The simulated pairs isolate appearance changes, whereas real pairs also retain uncertainty from registration and anatomical variation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估了对氧化物配对的CT-CBCT对的预测一致性,然后评估已登记的CT-CBCT和CT-MRI对的预测一致性。 模拟对子隔离外观变化,而真实对子也保留了注册和解剖变异的不确定性.

blocks.en: Voxel-aligned simulated pairs. On 497 TS_RTK pairs (Figure 3 a), the CT-to-CBCT Dice decrease was 0.025 for IMPACT-Seg 2.5D and 0.022 for 3D, compared with 0.178 for TotalSegmentator, 0.153 for NV-Segment-CTMR, and 0.176 for CADS (all p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: Voxel-accessed 模拟对. 在497对TS_RTK(图3a)中,CT对CBCT的滴水量减少为0.025,IMPACT-Seg 2.5D和0.022对3D,相比之下,总分数为0.178,NV-Segment-CTMR为0.153,CADS为0.176(均p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en:
The source CTs belong to cohorts used to train TotalSegmentator and CADS, whereas IMPACT-Seg was evaluated out of fold. On the simulated CBCTs, TotalSegmentator and CADS achieved lower Dice (0.741 and 0.740) than IMPACT-Seg (0.833 and 0.855).
CT-CBCT prediction agreement reached 0.908 and 0.926 for IMPACT-Seg, compared with 0.776, 0.748, and 0.774, respectively. Detector blur and respiratory motion were associated with the largest Dice decreases for the compared frameworks; corresponding decreases were approximately three to four times smaller for IMPACT-Seg (Figure S11 ).
blocks.zh:
来源CT属于用来培训TotalSegmentator和CADS的组别,而IMPACT-Seg则被评价为不折不扣. 在模拟的CBCT中,总分仪和CADS实现了低于IMPACT-Seg(0.833和0.855)的Dice(0.741和0.740).
CT-CBCT预测协议对IMPACT-Seg达成0.908和0.926,而分别是0.776,0.748和0.774. 检测器模糊和呼吸运动与比较框架的最大剂量减少有关;相应的减少大约是IMPACT-Seg(图S11)的3至4倍。

blocks.en: Real paired data. On 139 registered SynthRAD CT-CBCT pairs, agreement was 0.864 and 0.881 for IMPACT-Seg 2.5D and 3D, compared with 0.692 for NV-Segment-CTMR, 0.492 for TotalSegmentator, and 0.489 for CADS. On 52 CT-MRI pairs, the corresponding values were 0.785 and 0.790, compared with 0.762 for MRSegmentator, 0.673 for TotalSegmentator, and 0.588 for NV-Segment-CTMR. IMPACT-Seg therefore achieved the highest agreement in both settings. These scores combine prediction consistency with residual registration uncertainty and do not measure correctness against an independent reference. Figure S7 provides surface-based examples.
blocks.zh: 真实配对数据. 在139对注册的SynthRAD CT-CBCT配对中,IMPACT-Seg 2.5D和3D的协议分别为0.864和0.881,而NV-Segment-CTMR协议为0.692,总分号为0.492,CADS协议为0.489。 在52对CT-MRI中,对应值为0.785和0.790,而MRSegator为0.762,TotalSegator为0.673,NV-Segament-CTMR为0.588。 因此,IMPACT-Seg在两种情况下都达成了最高一致。 这些分数将预测一致性与剩余登记不确定性结合起来,不对照独立参考衡量正确性。 图S7提供了基于表面的例子。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 CBCT
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 CBCT

blocks.en: Real CBCT. On 139 SynthRAD CBCT scans (89 labels), IMPACT-Seg achieved mean Dice of 0.819 (2.5D) and 0.842 (3D), compared with 0.671 for the strongest competitor, NV-Segment-CTMR ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). IMPACT-Seg also had the lowest surface distances. The advantage held across anatomical regions and was largest in the pelvis; fewer partial failures were reflected in a narrower Dice distribution (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 真实的CBCT. 在139 SynthRAD CBCT扫描(89个标签)上,IMPACT-Seg实现了平均剂量为0.819(2.5D)和0.842(3D),而最强竞争者NV-Segment-CTMR( < 0.001 p < 0.001)则为0.671。 ImpACT-Seg的表面距离也最低。 解剖区之间的优势最大,骨盆;部分故障较少反映在较窄的虱子分布中(图4)。

blocks.en: Simulated CBCT. On 497 TS_RTK volumes (93 labels), Dice reached 0.833 (2.5D) and 0.855 (3D), compared with 0.741 for TotalSegmentator, the strongest competitor. Although competitors had seen the source CTs, IMPACT-Seg retained its advantage across structure-size strata on both CBCT benchmarks (Figure S12 ).
blocks.zh: 模拟CBCT. 在497 TS_RTK卷(93个标签)上,第斯达到0.833(2.5D)和0.855(3D),相比之下,TotalSectionator是最强的竞争对手. 虽然竞争者已经看到CT的来源,但IMPACT-Seg在CBCT两个基准(图S12)上都保留了在结构大小各阶层的优势。

blocks.en: External radiotherapy CBCT. Table 3 summarizes the results on the pancreatic radiotherapy cohort. On planning CT, automatic methods achieved comparable GI Dice (0.828 for both IMPACT-Seg 3D and TotalSegmentator, and 0.817 for NV-Segment-CTMR; p ≥ 0.47 p\geq 0.47 ). On daily CBCT, evaluated on identical voxels across methods, IMPACT-Seg 3D achieved a GI Dice of 0.735 [0.70, 0.77] and an HD95 of 9.5 mm, outperforming TotalSegmentator (0.634, 14.5 mm) and NV-Segment-CTMR (0.536, 20.7 mm; both p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The GI Dice decrease from planning CT to CBCT was 0.093 for IMPACT-Seg 3D, compared with 0.194 and 0.281 for the respective competitors, although these differences also reflect inter-fraction anatomical changes and independent delineations. Rigid propagation of planning contours achieved a lower GI Dice of 0.690 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) with a similar HD95 of 9.8 mm. However, propagation performed better on the individual small-bowel and stomach-duodenum structures (Dice 0.579 and 0.702, versus 0.477 and 0.690 for IMPACT-Seg 3D), partly reflecting the dataset’s duodenal delineation convention. On the ten CBCTs independently contoured by two observers, IMPACT-Seg 3D achieved a GI Dice of 0.795 against the observer contours, below the inter-observer agreement of 0.847 ( p = 0.01 p=0.01 ).
blocks.zh: 外部放射治疗 CBCT. 表3汇总了胰腺放射治疗组群的结果。 在规划CT时,自动方法实现了可比较的GI Dice(IMPACT-Seg 3D和TotalSigmentator均为0.828,NV-Sigment-CTMR为0.817;p 0.47 p\geq 0.47)。 在每日CBCT中,IMPACT-Seg 3D对不同方法的相同阴离子进行了评价,实现了0.735 [0.70, 0.77] 和9.5毫米的HD95, 性能优于总分数(0.634, 14.5 mm)和NV-Segment-CTMR(0.536, 20.7 mm; 两者都小于0.001 p<0.001 0.001 ). GI Dice在IMPACT-Seg 3D中从规划CT到CBCT的减少为0.093, 而相应的竞争者则分别是0.194和0.281,尽管这些差异也反映了解剖学间的变化和独立划分。 规划轮廓的严格传播实现了0.690的GI凹槽(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),类似的HD95为9.8毫米。 然而,在单个小毛巾和胃脏结构上的传播效果较好(对IMPACT-Seg 3D而言,分别为0.579和0.702,对0.477和0.690),部分反映了数据集的双层划定公约。 在由两名观察员独立组成的10个CBCT上,IMPACT-Seg 3D在观测者间协议0.847(p = 0.01 p = 0.01)之下,对观察员轮廓的GI Dice达到0.795。

blocks.en: Held-out VISCERAL CT. On 58 cases, Dice was 0.833 (2.5D) and 0.850 (3D), compared with 0.853 for TotalSegmentator and 0.798 for NV-Segment-CTMR. The 3D network did not differ significantly from TotalSegmentator ( p = 0.24 p=0.24 ); label-wise results are provided in Section S10 .
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). Hold-out VisCERAL CT. 在58起案件中,Dice为0.833(2.5D)和0.850(3D),而总分区为0.853,NV-分区为0.798。 3D网络与TotalSegmentator(p=0.24 p=0.24)没有显著区别;S10节提供了标签结果.

blocks.en: Vertebral and rib identification. Errors in the numbering of ribs and vertebrae explain a substantial part of the CT difference: merged-vertebra Dice on VISCERAL was 0.913 and 0.917, compared with 0.929 for TotalSegmentator, whereas correct level identification was 93%, 97%, and 98%, respectively. Similar patterns occurred for ribs, simulated CBCT, and external CT. Excluding vertebrae and ribs narrowed the CT gap while preserving the CBCT advantage (Table S10 ).
blocks.zh: 体外和肋骨鉴定 肋骨和椎骨的编号错误解释了CT差异的很大一部分:合并-椎骨. VISCERAL上的剂量为0.913和0.917,而总配位器的剂量为0.929,而正确的水平鉴定分别为93%、97%和98%。 肋骨、模拟CBCT和外部CT也有类似的模式。 不包括椎骨和肋骨,缩小了CT差距,同时保持CBCT的优势(表S10)。

blocks.en: External TotalSegmentator v3 CT. On 247 cases, IMPACT-Seg Dice was 0.799 (2.5D) and 0.831 (3D), below TotalSegmentator (0.932) and CADS (0.890; both p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The 3D ensemble improved Dice to 0.846; deficits were largest below 10 ml. TotalSegmentator Dice exceeded 0.99 for 9.7% of patient-structure pairs (1714/17 740), versus 0.5% for CADS and none for IMPACT-Seg. This suggests possible retention of automatic outputs in the references, potentially favouring their generating framework, but does not establish provenance or explain the full gap. Potential training overlap also limits independence.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2019-09-31). Official TablySector v3 CT. 在247起案件中,IMPACT-Seg Dice为0.799(2.5D)和0.831(3D),分别低于总分数(0.932)和CADS(0.890;两页均 < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 3D综艺将Dice改进为0.846;赤字最大,低于10毫升. 共计 在9.7%的病人结构配对(1714/17 740)中,剂量超过0.99,在CADS中则超过0.5%,在IMPACT-Seg中则没有。 这表明在参考文献中可能保留自动产出,可能有利于生成这些产出的框架,但没有确定来源或解释全部差距。 潜在的培训重叠也限制了独立性。
4.2.3 核磁共振

blocks.en: SynthRAD MRI. IMPACT-Seg achieved Dice of 0.817 (2.5D) and 0.822 (3D), comparable to TotalSegmentator (0.820) and MRSegmentator (0.803), and above NV-Segment-CTMR (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 合成RAD核磁共振。 IMPACT-Seg实现了0.817(2.5D)和0.822(3D)的剂量,与总分区(0.820)和MRS分区(0.803)相当,高于NV-分区-CTMR(表2)。

blocks.en: AMOS-MR and TotalSegmentator-MR. Dice reached 0.808/0.816 (2.5D/3D) on AMOS-MR and 0.732/0.768 on TotalSegmentator-MR. IMPACT-Seg was competitive on AMOS-MR and exceeded the evaluated competitors on TotalSegmentator-MR; TotalSegmentator MRI was excluded from its own training cohort.
blocks.zh: AMOS-MR和总分区-MR. AMOS-MR的Dice达到0.808/0.816(2.5D/3D),TotalSector-MR达到0.732/0.768. IMPACT-Seg在AMOS-MR上具有竞争力,超过了TotalSector-MR上被评价的竞争者;TotalSectorMRI被排除在自己的培训组之外.

blocks.en:
External TotalSegmentator v3 MRI. On 253 axial volumes, Dice was 0.758 (2.5D) and 0.778 (3D), below TotalSegmentator 2.4 (0.843) and MRSegmentator (0.812). The 3D ensemble reached 0.795.
The evaluated volumes combine 137 whole-body examinations from public collections of the NCI Imaging Data Commons and 116 examinations from University Hospital Basel, the source of the TotalSegmentator MRI dataset. Whole-body acquisitions are under-represented in our MRI training sources, whereas MRSegmentator was trained on a large whole-body Dixon cohort. Deficits were concentrated in small structures and a minority of partially failed cases (Figure S12 ).
blocks.zh:
外部TotalSecutionator v3 磁共振. 在253轴卷上,Dice是0.758(2.5D)和0.778(3D),低于总分号2.4(0.843)和MRS分号(0.812). 3D综艺节目达到0.795.
所评估的卷卷集结合了来自NCI成像数据公共集的137项全身检查和来自巴塞尔大学医院的116项检查,后者是总分仪磁共振数据集的来源。 整个机构采购在核磁共振培训来源中代表不足,而核磁共振培训者则接受大量整个机构狄克逊培训。 缺陷集中在小型结构中,少数是部分失败的案件(图S12)。

blocks.en: 4.2.4 All 126 Structures

The internal out-of-fold evaluation scores every structure present in the reference, including small structures and the individually numbered ribs, rather than only the labels shared with the compared frameworks. Across 838 cases, per-case Dice was 0.845/0.863 on CT, 0.803/0.824 on CBCT, and 0.682/0.704 on MRI (2.5D/3D). Of the 126 structures, 94 (2.5D) and 102 (3D) reached a median Dice of at least 0.8, and 41 and 45 at least 0.9; only the thin anterior eye segments remained below 0.5. Figure 5 summarizes performance by region; Figures S8 - S9 provide all structures. Simulated CBCT remained close to source CT, whereas real CBCT and MRI were more challenging (cohort details in Figure S10 ).

blocks.en: 4.2.5 2.5D versus 3D Networks
blocks.zh: 4.2.5 2.5D 对 三维网络

blocks.en: On identical out-of-fold cases and patient-label pairs, the 3D network achieved higher mean Dice and lower HD95 on every benchmark (Table S11 ). The largest Dice gains occurred on real CBCT, external CT, and TotalSegmentator-MR (all p < 0.001 p<0.001 after Holm correction); differences on SynthRAD and AMOS MRI were not significant. Volumetric context particularly improved level identification: correct vertebral numbering rose from 93% to 97% on VISCERAL and from 87% to 92% on external CT. CT-CBCT degradation and CT-MRI agreement remained similar between networks. The 3D network therefore favours accuracy, whereas 2.5D offers approximately twice the CT inference speed (Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 在相同的双倍病例和病人标签配对上,3D网络在每个基准(表S11)上实现了更高的平均剂量和较低的HD95。 实际CBCT、外部CT和TotalSegmentator-MR(在Holm校正后均小于0.001 p < 0.001)的Dice增量最大;SynthRAD和AMOS磁共振方面的差异不大。 卷状环境特别改进了水平识别:在VISCERAL中,正确的脊椎编号从93%上升到97%,在外部CT中从87%上升到92%。 网络之间的CT-CBCT退化和CT-MRI协议依然相似。 因此,3D网络倾向于准确性,而2.5D提供大约两倍于CT推论速度(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.2.6 Training Data Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.2.6 培训数据缺失

blocks.en: We assessed the contribution of each training modality to segmentation accuracy and cross-modality prediction consistency by progressively expanding the training set.
blocks.zh: 我们通过逐步扩大培训范围,评估了每一种培训模式对分门别类准确性和跨模式预测一致性的贡献。

blocks.en: The all-modality ablation variant scored up to 0.03 Dice below the main fold-1 model (Table 4 ), which was trained using a longer SGD schedule.
blocks.zh: 全模式的减速变体在主折叠-1模型(表4)下得分高达0.03分,该模型使用更长的SGD时间表来训练.

blocks.en: Simulated CBCT and transfer to real CBCT. Adding real CBCT improved segmentation accuracy on clinical CBCT, while simulated CBCT provided further gains in accuracy and CT-CBCT prediction agreement (Table 4 ). Improvements were larger on simulated CBCT than on real CBCT, although the latter supports transfer beyond the simulation domain. Since adding simulations also increased CBCT exposure during training, these effects cannot be attributed to simulation alone. Notably, the CT-only variant already outperformed the compared frameworks on real SynthRAD CBCT, indicating that the overall advantage of IMPACT-Seg does not rely solely on CBCT-specific training.
blocks.zh: 模拟CBCT并转移到真正的CBCT. 将真正的CBCT添加到临床上的CBCT改进了分化精度,而模拟CBCT则在精度和CT-CBCT预测协议方面提供了进一步的增益(表4). 模拟CBCT的改进大于真正的CBCT,尽管后者支持超出模拟域的传输. 由于添加模拟也增加了训练期间的CBCT暴露,这些效果不能单独归因于模拟. 值得注意的是,只使用CT的变体已经超过了真正的SynthRAD CBCT的比较框架,表明IMPACT-Seg的整体优势并不完全依赖于CBCT特定培训.

blocks.en: Joint training preserves CT and CBCT performance. Adding MRI was essential for MRI segmentation (Dice ≤ 0.22 \leq 0.22 without MRI), while reducing CT and CBCT Dice by at most 0.012 and leaving CT-to-CBCT degradation nearly unchanged. Thus, joint training enabled segmentation across all three modalities with minimal loss of CT and CBCT performance.
blocks.zh: 联合培训保持CT和CBCT的性能. 添加核磁共振对核磁共振分解至关重要(没有核磁共振的Dice 0.22\leq 0.22),同时将CT和CBCT分解减少最多0.012,使CT到CBC的降解几乎保持不变。 因此,联合培训能够在所有三种模式中实现分化,同时尽量减少CT和CBCT性能的损失。

blocks.en: 4.3 Feature-Level Consistency and Downstream Registration
blocks.zh: 4.3 地物水平一致性和下游登记

blocks.en: We first examined whether the learned representations capture anatomical correspondence across modalities, and then assessed their utility beyond segmentation through a downstream deformable registration task.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查所学到的表述是否涵盖不同模式的解剖对应,然后通过下游可变形登记任务评估其除分化之外的用途。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Cross-Modality Feature Correspondence
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 跨模式 专题通讯

blocks.en: Variation across depth. Early encoder features were sensitive to local appearance and poorly localized anatomical correspondences, with mean patient-wise median retrieval errors of 45-60 mm at the first stage against a chance level of approximately 68 mm. The fifth encoder stage was most spatially selective: the main fold-1 model achieved mean patient-wise median retrieval errors of 1.3 mm on simulated CBCT, 1.8 mm on real CBCT, and 3.1 mm on MRI (Figure 6 ). Last-decoder features showed high cross-modality cosine similarity (0.96-0.99) but broader responses within individual structures, with retrieval errors of 4.2, 7.0, and 16.7 mm, respectively.
blocks.zh: 变化的深度。 早期编码器的特征对局部外观很敏感,解剖学对应的局部性不强,在第一阶段,平均患者的中位检索误差为45-60毫米,而机会级约为68毫米. 第五个编码器阶段在空间上最具选择性:主折叠-1模型在模拟CBCT上实现的患者平均中位检索误差为1.3毫米,真CBCT上为1.8毫米,核磁共振上为3.1毫米(图6). 最后的解码器特征显示出高度的跨式余弦相似性(0.96-0.99),但单个结构内的反应范围更广,检索错误分别为4.2,7.0和16.7毫米.

blocks.en: Association with training data. CT-only encoder retrieval was already accurate for CBCT ( 2.0 ± 0.6 2.0\pm 0.6 and 2.3 ± 0.7 2.3\pm 0.7 mm for simulated and real CBCT; mean ± \pm standard deviation across patients), but far from the corresponding position for MRI ( 44.0 ± 23.9 44.0\pm 23.9 mm). Adding simulated CBCT increased last-decoder CT-simulated-CBCT CKA from 0.900 ± 0.076 0.900\pm 0.076 to 0.965 ± 0.036 0.965\pm 0.036 and reduced retrieval error from 9.7 ± 4.1 9.7\pm 4.1 to 4.9 ± 2.2 4.9\pm 2.2 mm (Table S12 ). The same addition improved real-CBCT CKA from 0.912 ± 0.053 0.912\pm 0.053 to 0.934 ± 0.048 0.934\pm 0.048 and retrieval from 10.4 ± 4.1 10.4\pm 4.1 to 8.1 ± 3.6 8.1\pm 3.6 mm (both p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), supporting transfer beyond simulated appearance. Adding MRI increased CT-MRI CKA from 0.346 ± 0.235 0.346\pm 0.235 to 0.910 ± 0.044 0.910\pm 0.044 and reduced fifth-encoder retrieval error from 36.8 ± 22.8 36.8\pm 22.8 to 3.2 ± 0.5 3.2\pm 0.5 mm; last-decoder retrieval remained coarser at 17.2 ± 3.3 17.2\pm 3.3 mm. Thus, supervision improved both representational similarity and localization, with a persistent distinction between spatially selective encoder features and broader decoder responses.
blocks.zh: 与培训数据联系。 CT唯一的编码器检索对于CBCT来说已经是准确的(模拟和真实的CBCT来说是2.0±0.6 2.0\pm 0.6和2.3±0.7 2.3\pm 0.7mm;指±\pm标准差跨患者),但与核磁共振的相应位置(44.0±23.9 44.0\pm 23.9mm)相差甚远. 添加模拟CBCT将最后一解码器CT模拟-CBCT CKA从0.900±0.076 0.900\pm 0.076增加到0.965±0.036 0.965\pm 0.036,并将检索误差从9.7±4.1 9.7\pm 4.1减少到4.9±2.2 4.9\pm 2.2毫米(表S12)。 同样的加法改进了真CBCT CKA,从0.912±0.053 0.912\pm 0.053到0.934±0.048 0.934\pm 0.048,再从10.4±4.10.4\pm 4.1到8.1±3.6 8.1\pm 3.6毫米(均为p < 0.05 p < 0.05),支持超出模拟外观的转移. 加入核磁共振使CT-MRI CKA从0.346±0.235 0.346\pm0.235增加到0.910±0.044 0.910\pm0.044,并将第五编码器检索错误从36.8±22.8 36.8\pm 22.8减少到3.2±0.5 3.2\pm 0.5毫米;最后一次解码器检索仍为17.2±3.3 17.2\pm 3.3毫米. 因此,监督改进了代表性的相似性和局部性,始终区分空间选择性编码器特征和更广泛的解码器反应。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Downstream Task: Multimodal Registration
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 下游任务:多式联运登记

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the learned representations are useful beyond segmentation and local feature correspondence, we applied IMPACT-Seg features to deformable multimodal registration on two Learn2Reg benchmarks. The resulting pipelines ranked first on both AbdomenMRCT (Dice 0.917) and ThoraxCBCT (Dice 0.762; Table 5 ), with the lowest or tied-lowest HD95. Compared with our previous Elastix-IMPACT submissions [ 11 ] , Dice increased by 0.04 and 0.11, respectively. ThoraxCBCT landmark TRE remained within the range of the other top entries, while larger SDlogJ values indicated greater variability in local volume change.
blocks.zh: 为了评估所学到的表述是否除了分解和本地特征对应之外有用,我们根据两个 " Learn2Reg " 基准,将IMPACT-Seg特征应用于可变形的多式联运登记。 由此产生的管道在AbdomenMRCT(第0.917次)和ShoraxCBCT(第0.762次;表5)中排名第一,最低或最低的HD95。 与我们以前提交的Elastix-IMPACT[11]相比,Dice分别增加了0.04和0.11。 ThoraxCBCT标志性的TRE仍然在其它顶部条目的范围之内,而较大的SDlogJ值则表明局部体积变化较大.

blocks.en: These results demonstrate that the multimodal representations learned through segmentation supervision can serve as a semantic similarity measure for a downstream registration task.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,通过分块监管而获得的多式联运表述可作为下游登记任务的语义相似性措施。

blocks.en: 4.4 Detecting Failures Without a Reference
blocks.zh: 4.4 无参考资料的检测失败

blocks.en: On external CT and MRI datasets, disagreement between the five fold models was the most effective indicator of segmentation failures (AUROC 0.92–0.94, AUPRC 0.73–0.83; Table 6 ). This performance was not solely explained by structure size, as fold disagreement maintained high AUROC values (0.89–0.95) when evaluated separately across structure-volume categories, compared with 0.57–0.70 for volume alone (Table S15 ). In contrast, single-model entropy was less effective, particularly for the 3D network (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 关于外部的CT和磁共振数据集,五个折叠模型之间的分歧是分裂失败的最有效指标(AUROC 0.92-0.94, AUPRC 0.73-083;表6)。 这种性能并不仅仅以结构大小来解释,因为折叠分歧在结构数量类别中分别评价时保持了高的AUROC值(0.89-0.95),而单是数量就0.57-0.70(表S15)。 相比之下,单型 en的功效较低,特别是对3D网络而言(表6).

blocks.en: Reviewing the 20% most uncertain structures captured 75% and 81% of failures for 2.5D and 3D, respectively (Table S16 ). Entirely missed structures remained undetectable: 75 failures for 2.5D and 88 for 3D. Both networks were overconfident at voxel level (Figure S1 ); Figure S4 illustrates flagged failures. These results support prioritizing review on the evaluated diagnostic cohorts; treatment-CBCT performance and deployment thresholds remain unvalidated.
blocks.zh: 审查了20%最不确定的结构,发现2.5D和3D的故障率分别为75%和81%(表S16)。 完全漏掉的结构仍然无法探测:2.5D有75次故障,3D有88次故障。 两个网络在阴道水平上都过度自信(图S1);图S4说明了标记的失败。 这些结果有助于优先审查已评估的诊断组群;治疗-CBCT性能和部署阈值仍未证实。

blocks.en: 4.5 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.5 计算效率

blocks.en: IMPACT-Seg is implemented with KonfAI, which enables fast, memory-efficient, out-of-core inference and supports deployment across a wide range of hardware configurations, including memory-constrained systems. End-to-end inference on an RTX A6000 required 8.0 s for a whole-body CT with 2.5D and 14.8 s with 3D; CBCT and MRI required approximately 2 s (Table 7 ). On CT, the evaluated competitor configurations required 82 s for NV-Segment-CTMR, 328 s for TotalSegmentator, and 114 s for one CADS part model or 555 s for all nine. These measurements include preprocessing, patch inference, reconstruction, and output writing, using 30 volumes per modality with the models loaded once per run. Peak IMPACT-Seg GPU memory remained below 6 GB for one fold and 9 GB for the five-fold ensemble. Detailed network-only timings and competitor memory use are reported in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: IMPACT-Seg与KonfAI一起实施,它能够快速,内存高效,核心外推论,并支持在包括内存约束系统在内的各种硬件配置上部署. 对RTX A6000的端到端推论需要8.0s的整体CT,2.5D,14.8s的3D;CBCT和核磁共振需要约2s(表7)。 在CT上,被评价的竞争者配置需要82 s的NV-Segment-CTMR,328 s的TotalSegmentator,114 s的CADS一个部分模型或555 s的所有9个. 这些测量包括预处理、补丁推论、重建以及产出书写,使用每个模式30卷,每跑一次加载模型。 Peak IMPACT-Seg GPU内存仍低于 6 GB 一个折叠,9 GB 为五倍共鸣. 详细的网络专用计时和竞争对手内存使用情况见表7。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: IMPACT-Seg combines harmonized anatomical labels, joint multimodal training, and physics-based CBCT simulation to enable dense segmentation across CT, CBCT, and MRI. Our results demonstrate improved robustness to CT-to-CBCT appearance changes and greater consistency between predictions across modalities compared with existing methods. Feature analyses further reveal that this shared anatomical supervision promotes anatomical correspondence in the learned representations, without explicit feature-alignment objectives. These representations were also successfully integrated into IMPACT-Reg, supporting improved performance on multimodal deformable registration benchmarks.
blocks.zh: IMPACT-Seg结合了统一的解剖标签、联合多式联运培训和基于物理学的CBCT模拟,使CT、CBCT和核磁共振之间的密分化成为可能。 我们的结果表明,与现有方法相比,CT到CBCT的外观变化更加强劲,不同模式的预测更加一致。 特征分析进一步表明,这种共同的解剖监督促进在学到的表述中进行解剖通信,而没有明确的特征协调目标。 这些表述也成功纳入了IMPACT-Reg,有助于改进多式联运可变形登记基准的绩效。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Failure cases, selected on all five folds by the mean of the 2.5D and 3D networks. Top: held-out CT with the lowest rate of correctly identified vertebral levels; vertebrae are coloured by level, so that a level shift appears as a colour change: the 2.5D network shifts the lumbar levels, which the 3D network identifies correctly. Middle: external MRI with the lowest Dice (partial liver miss of the 2.5D network, recovered by the 3D network). Bottom: real thoracic CBCT with the lowest Dice; ribs and vertebrae are delineated but shifted by one level by both networks. Titles give the mean Dice of the case.
blocks.zh: 图7 失败案例,按照2.5D和3D网络的平均值在所有五个折叠上选择. 顶部:有正确识别的脊椎关节率最低的持有式CT;顶部以关节为颜色,这样,一个关节的移位就以颜色变化的形式出现: 2.5D的网络会转动立体关节关节级,3D的网络会正确识别. 中段:最低剂量的外部核磁共振(部分肝脏错失2.5D网络,由3D网络恢复). 底部:真实的胸腔CBCT,最低的Dice;肋骨和椎骨被划定,但两个网络都通过一个级别转移. 标题给出了这个案子的刻薄。

blocks.en: External radiotherapy validation. On an independent pancreatic radiotherapy cohort, IMPACT-Seg 3D performed comparably to other automatic methods on planning CT but showed substantially less degradation on daily CBCT, with approximately half the GI Dice decrease observed for TotalSegmentator. It also outperformed rigid contour propagation for the combined gastrointestinal region, despite breath-hold acquisitions favouring propagation. However, propagation achieved higher Dice for individual structures, partly reflecting the dataset’s duodenal delineation convention, while IMPACT-Seg agreement with expert contours remained below inter-observer agreement. These findings support automatic segmentation as a complement to contour propagation in adaptive radiotherapy, with expert review remaining necessary.
blocks.zh: 对外放射治疗鉴定. 在一个独立的胰腺放射治疗组中,IMPACT-Seg 3D在规划CT时与其他自动方法相匹配,但在每日CBCT中表现出的降解程度要小得多,观察到总分解器的GI dice减少约一半。 它在综合肠胃区域也表现优于硬质的轮廓传播,尽管气压的获得有利于传播。 然而,单体结构的传播达到更高的剂量,部分反映了数据集的双体划界公约,而与专家轮廓的IMPACT-Seg协议仍然低于观测者之间的协议。 这些调查结果支持自动分离,作为对适应性放射治疗中轮廓传播的补充,仍然需要专家审查。

blocks.en: Anatomical consistency without explicit feature alignment. The feature analysis distinguishes cross-modality similarity from spatial discrimination. Deep encoder features identify corresponding positions more precisely, whereas last-decoder features exhibit high cross-modality similarity but broader responses within anatomical structures. This distinction is particularly relevant for registration, where features must provide both consistent anatomical correspondence and sufficiently localized similarity to guide deformation. Joint multimodal supervision improved both properties, with MRI correspondence particularly dependent on MRI exposure. The downstream registration experiments further demonstrated that these representations can support multimodal deformable registration, extending their utility beyond segmentation. However, the evaluated pipelines used last-decoder features as a semantic similarity objective, and the relative contribution of the learned features and other registration components was not isolated. The sharper localization of deep encoder features also makes them promising candidates for future registration objectives. Together, these findings complement appearance-robust pretraining in Anatomix [ 13 ] and semantic registration losses in IMPACT [ 11 ] , showing that useful multimodal representations can emerge from dense segmentation supervision without an explicit feature-alignment objective.
blocks.zh: 解剖学上的一致性,但不明确特征对齐. 特征分析将跨模式相似性与空间歧视区分开来. 深编码器特征更准确地确定相应的位置,而最后的解码器特征显示出高度的跨模式相似性,但在解剖结构中则有更广泛的反应. 这种区分与登记特别相关,因为登记的特点必须既提供一致的解剖通信,又提供足够本地化的相似性,以指导变形。 联合多式联运监督改进了这两种特性,核磁共振对应尤其依赖于核磁共振的暴露。 下游的登记试验进一步表明,这些说明可以支持可变形的多式联运登记,将其效用扩大到分化之外。 然而,被评价的管道使用最后的解码器特征作为语义相似性目标,所学特征和其他注册组件的相对贡献并不是孤立的. 深层编码器特征的更锐利本地化也使它们对未来的登记目标很有希望。 这些结论加在一起补充了Anatomix [13] 的外观-软体预训和IMPACT [11] 的语义登记损失,表明有用的多式联运表述可能来自密集的分区监督,而没有明确的特征协调目标。

blocks.en: Dense anatomical coverage. The shared label space enables consistent delineation of 126 anatomical structures across CT, CBCT, and MRI, including cardiac substructures, muscles, and head-and-neck organs at risk (Figure S13 ). While comparisons with existing frameworks are limited to the structures supported by each method (39–104 labels), our internal evaluation covers all 126 structures, providing a more comprehensive assessment of the framework’s anatomical coverage.
blocks.zh: 解剖学报道 共用的标签空间能够一致地划分跨CT、CBCT和核磁共振的126个解剖结构,包括心脏亚结构、肌肉和有危险的头颈器官(图S13)。 虽然与现有框架的比较仅限于每种方法所支持的结构(39-104标签),但我们的内部评价涵盖了所有126个结构,对框架的解剖范围提供了更全面的评估。

blocks.en: Improved confidence measures for uncertainty-guided review. Disagreement between the five fold models proved effective in identifying segmentation failures, even when accounting for differences in anatomical structure size. This approach could help prioritize structures requiring manual review and correction [ 59 , 54 ] , although it requires predictions from multiple models. In contrast, uncertainty estimates derived from single-model confidence were less reliable. Further validation in clinical radiotherapy workflows is needed to determine whether uncertainty-guided review can improve efficiency and segmentation reliability.
blocks.zh: 改进以不确定性为导向审查的建立信任措施。 事实证明,五个折叠模型之间的分歧在识别分解故障方面是有效的,即使考虑到解剖结构大小的差异。 这种办法可能有助于确定需要人工审查和纠正的结构的优先次序[59、54],尽管它需要从多个模型中作出预测。 与此相反,单一模型信任产生的不确定性估计数不太可靠。 需要进一步验证临床放射治疗工作流程,以确定以不确定性为指南的审查是否能够提高效率和分化可靠性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5.1 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: External MRI generalization. Small structures and partially failed cases account for much of the external MRI gap. Limited protocol coverage is a plausible contributor, although protocol effects were not isolated. Broader sampling across sequences, field strengths, and institutions, together with non-axial slab augmentation, merits evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对外核磁共振通论. 结构小和部分失败的案例占外部核磁共振差距的大部分。 有限的协议覆盖面是一个可信的贡献者,尽管协议的效果并不是孤立的。 跨序列、实地优势和机构以及非轴板增强的更广泛的抽样值得评价。

blocks.en: Vertebral and rib numbering. Most of the residual CT gap with TotalSegmentator arises from level identification rather than boundary delineation. Counting vertebrae and ribs requires cranio-caudal context that the 2.5D input does not provide; the 3D network reduces this error, and an explicit spine-ordering post-processing step is a natural next improvement.
blocks.zh: 胸口和肋骨的编号 遗留的CT与总分线的缺口大多来自水平识别而不是边界划定。 计算脊椎和肋骨需要2.5D输入不能提供的cranio-caudal上下文;3D网络减少这个错误,一个明显的脊椎排列后处理步骤是自然的下一个改进.

blocks.en: Reference quality and evaluation bias. Despite iterative refinement and manual review, the pseudo-labeled references may retain systematic errors inherited from the generating models. Their quality and completeness vary across cohorts and structures, potentially introducing biases in comparisons with existing segmentation frameworks. Future validation should include a stratified expert audit and report performance separately for original annotations, pseudo-labeled structures, and manually corrected structures.
blocks.zh: 参考质量和评价偏差。 尽管进行了反复的改进和手工审查,但伪标签的参考文献可能保留从生成模型中继承下来的系统性错误。 其质量和完整性因组别和结构而异,有可能在与现有分类框架的比较中引入偏见。 未来的审定应当包括分级的专家审计和分别报告绩效,以获取原始说明,伪标签结构,人工校正结构.

blocks.en: Clinical translation. The paper quantifies segmentation accuracy, cross-modality consistency and registration performance, but not the clinical consequence of residual segmentation errors. A prospective or retrospective radiotherapy study should now measure manual correction time, contour acceptability and dosimetric impact in adaptive workflows.
blocks.zh: 临床翻译. 纸质量化分解精度,跨模式一致性和注册性能,但不包括残留分解误差的临床后果. 一项预期或追溯性放射疗法研究现在应当衡量人工校正时间、轮廓可接受性和适应工作流程的剂量影响。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: IMPACT-Seg combines harmonized anatomical supervision, joint multimodal training, and physics-based CBCT simulation to segment 126 anatomical structures across CT, CBCT, and MRI using shared network parameters. Our results demonstrate improved robustness to CBCT appearance changes and greater consistency of anatomical predictions across modalities. Beyond segmentation, the learned representations capture anatomical correspondences that can be leveraged to improve multimodal deformable registration with IMPACT-Reg. IMPACT-Seg also provides a fast and memory-efficient segmentation tool, with the 2.5D model segmenting a whole-body CT in just 8 seconds. Uncertainty-based failure detection further supports its potential for targeted expert review in adaptive radiotherapy. The publicly available datasets, models, and code provide a foundation for further multimodal research, while future clinical studies should assess contour acceptability, manual correction time, and dosimetric impact.
blocks.zh: IMPACT-Seg将统一的解剖学监督、联合多式联运培训和基于物理学的CBCT模拟结合到跨CT、CBCT和MRI的126段解剖结构中,使用共享的网络参数。 我们的结果显示,CBCT的外观变化更加有力,各种模式的解剖预测更加一致。 除了分解外,学到的表示法还捕捉了解剖学的对应物,这些对应物可以用来改进与IMPACT-Reg的多式联运变形登记. IMPACT-Seg还提供了快速和内存高效的分解工具,2.5D模型在短短8秒内将一个整体CT分解. 基于不确定性的故障检测进一步支持其在适应性放射疗法方面进行有针对性的专家审查的潜力。 公开的数据集、模型和代码为进一步开展多式联运研究提供了基础,而未来的临床研究应评估可接受性、人工校正时间和剂量影响。

blocks.en: External TotalSegmentator v3 cohorts. MRI volumes acquired in coronal or sagittal slabs (largest voxel dimension not along the cranio-caudal axis) were excluded for every method, leaving 391 axial or isotropic MRI volumes. Because IMPACT-Seg targets adult radiotherapy imaging from the head and neck to the pelvis, examinations outside this scope were excluded using identical metadata- and reference-based criteria for all methods: paediatric patients (age below 14 years or paediatric protocol), limb and joint examinations, volumes whose reference contains less than 50 ml of structures other than limb bones and muscles, and skull-only volumes in which the brain makes up at least half of the reference volume (without a shared brain label, these volumes would otherwise be scored only on the upper cervical spine). Final comparisons also required an available output from every compared method. This yielded 247 of 712 CT and 253 of 391 MRI volumes (CT: 264 paediatric, 36 limb, 165 skull-only; MRI: 119 paediatric, 11 limb-only, 3 skull-only, 5 without NV-Segment-CTMR output).
blocks.zh: 外部总分区v3组. 每个方法都排除了在冠状或亚基状板上获得的磁共振磁共振卷(最大的阴道维度不沿着阴道轴),留下391个轴状或异热带磁共振卷。 由于IMPACT-Seg针对的是从头部和颈部到骨盆的成人放射治疗成像,因此排除了这一范围以外的检查,对所有方法采用相同的基于元数据和参考标准:儿科病人(不满14岁或儿科规程),肢体和联合检查,其参考量中除四肢骨骼和肌肉以外的结构不到50毫升,以及脑至少占参考量一半的仅头骨卷(没有共同的大脑标签,否则这些卷只得在上宫颈脊椎上方). 最后比较还需要从每一种比较方法中取得产出。 这产生了247个712个CT和253个391个核磁共振卷(CT:264个儿科,36个肢体,165个颅骨;核磁共振:119个儿科,11个肢体,3个颅骨,5个没有NV-Segment-CTMR输出).

blocks.en: S2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: S2 执行 细节

blocks.en: Geometry audits. In addition to checking image-label geometry, cohort-level heuristics flagged suspicious direction matrices, rare orientation codes, unexpected header scaling, and plausible permutations of the spatial axes. Such checks cannot detect an image and mask that share the same erroneous geometry. Volumes with slices thinner than 0.5 mm were excluded; those thicker then 0.5 mm and thinner than 1.5 mm were resampled to 1.5 mm along the cranio-caudal axis. Anatomical numbering and label-volume outliers was used to select cases for manual review.
blocks.zh: 几何审计. 除了检查图像标签几何外,组群水平的热度还标出可疑方向矩阵、稀有方向代码、意想不到的标题缩放以及空间轴的似似似形状。 这种检查无法检测出一个具有相同错误几何特征的图像和面具。 切片薄度大于0.5毫米的体积不包括在内;那些厚度大于0.5毫米、薄度大于1.5毫米的体积则沿着Cranio-caudal轴重印为1.5毫米。 采用解剖编号和标签批量输出器来选择进行人工审查的案件。

blocks.en: CBCT simulation. CT Hounsfield units were converted to linear attenuation coefficients before projection. After FDK reconstruction, intensities were mapped back to a HU-like scale and resampled onto the source CT grid. Acquisition geometries were sampled from priors representative of common on-board devices. Physics-based degradations simulated during projection generation and image reconstruction were Poisson noise, scatter, detector saturation and blur, low-frequency shading, field-of-view truncation, and isocentre miscentring, with occasionally coarser reconstruction spacing. Parameters remained within clinically plausible ranges to avoid sparse-view aliasing [ 6 ] . Without 4D CT, respiratory motion was synthesized by displacing the lungs, heart, and upper abdominal organs of the static CT, mainly cranio-caudally (up to about 11 mm), using smoothed reference masks. This yielded four to eight phases around the source CT. Projections were interpolated between phases along a quasi-periodic breathing signal. Dental, sternal, hip, and spinal implants were positioned using anatomical masks to generate metal artefacts.
blocks.zh: CBCT模拟. CT 翻译 Hounsfield单位在预测前被转换为线性衰减系数. FDK重建后,强度被映射回类似HU的尺度,并重印到源CT网格上. 采购的几何图样从代表机上通用设备的前身中抽取。 在投影生成和图像重建过程中模拟的基于物理的降解是普瓦松噪声,散射,探测器饱和和和模糊,低频阴影,视场截流,以及异位中心错集中,偶尔还有较凝固的重建间隔. 参数仍然在临床上可行的范围内,以避免零星的视野别名[6]。 没有4D CT,呼吸运动通过取代静态CT的肺部,心脏和上腹部器官来合成,主要使用光滑的参考口罩进行cranio-caudally(最高约11毫米). 由此在源CT周围形成了四至八个阶段. 预测沿准周期呼吸信号在各阶段之间进行了内插。 牙科、胸腔、臀部和脊椎植入物均使用解剖口罩定位,以产生金属制品。

blocks.en: Architecture and augmentation. The 2.5D encoder has six stages with 32, 64, 128, 256, 320, and 512 features and 1, 3, 4, 6, 6, and 6 residual blocks, respectively. Brightness, contrast, Gaussian noise, blur, and low-resolution augmentations were each applied with probability 0.15. Blur was two-dimensional or three-dimensional according to the network. Foreground-centered sampling and omission of spatial flips are specified in Section 3.5 .
blocks.zh: 建筑与增强. 2.5D编码器有6个级,分别为32,64,128,256,320,以及512个特征和1,3,4,6,6和6个残块. 亮度,对比度,高斯噪声,模糊度,低分辨率的增强均以概率0.15应用. 根据网络,模糊是二维或三维的。 第3.5节具体规定了以前景为中心的取样和忽略空间翻转。

blocks.en: Training-data ablation. The four 2.5D fold-1 variants used AdamW with a learning rate warmed up to 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} over 25 000 steps, followed by cosine decay scheduled over 500 000 steps; other settings matched the main training configuration. The CT-only and full-multimodal variants reached their lowest validation loss at 200 000 steps, with subsequent validation Dice changes below 0.01. The other variants were therefore evaluated at the same 200 000-step checkpoint, following the same learning-rate trajectory. Validation included only the modalities present in each training set. Uniform slice sampling changed modality exposure as data were added; this is not a control at fixed sample count or modality frequency.

blocks.en: S9 Patch Reconstruction
blocks.zh: S9 补丁重建

blocks.en: Overlapping patches can be merged either by keeping, at each voxel, the label of the most confident patch (our default) or, as in nnU-Net, by accumulating the class probabilities of all patches with a Gaussian weighting window and taking the argmax at the end. We compared both strategies with the same 2.5D fold-1 model on the fold-1 cases of every benchmark and of the internal test set, using the same evaluated cases and labels as in the main text (Table S17 ). Gaussian-weighted averaging changed the mean Dice by at most 0.002 on every benchmark, with median paired differences of 0.000, and the mean HD95 by less than 0.2 mm except on the external TotalSegmentator CT cases (11.8 versus 10.6 mm). Overall Dice was insensitive to the fusion strategy in this 2.5D fold-1 comparison. The principal observed difference was memory use: on a whole-body CT, probability averaging raised the peak GPU memory of the 3D network from 4.3 to 12.1 GB, because the 132 class probabilities of the whole volume must be accumulated, whereas the 2.5D network (batch of 16 slices) was barely affected (3.1 versus 3.3 GB) and the inference time was unchanged. Given the comparable segmentation accuracy observed in 2.5D and the substantially lower memory footprint in 3D, we retained maximum-confidence fusion as the default reconstruction strategy.
blocks.zh: 重叠补丁可以合并,要么在每个 voxel 上保留最自信补丁(我们的默认)的标签,要么像 nnU-Net 一样,用高斯加权窗口积累所有补丁的类概率,并在结尾取格马克斯. 我们使用与正文(表S17)相同的评价大小写和标签,将两种战略与每个基准和内部测试套件的折叠-1的相同2.5D折叠-1模型进行比较。 高斯加权平均值改变了平均值 每个基准最多0.002分,中位对比差异为0.000,平均HD95小于0.2毫米,但外部总分量CT病例除外(11.8对10.6毫米)。 总的来说,Dice在2.5D折叠-1比较中对聚变策略不敏感. 观察到的主要差异是内存使用:在全体CT上,概率平均值将3D网络的顶峰GPU内存从4.3升至12.1GB,因为整个容积的132类概率必须累积,而2.5D网络(16片的批次)则几乎没有受到影响(3.1对3.3GB),推断时间不变. 鉴于2.5D中观察到的可比较分解精度和3D中记忆足迹大大降低,我们保留了最大自信聚变作为默认重建策略.
